requirements.title: A user can add a participant with a name
requirements.acceptance_criteria: After adding a participant with a name, that name is shown in the app (competitor selector or standings).

requirements.title: A user can register a result per event
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A result saved for a participant and an event is shown for that participant under that event.

requirements.title: Points are calculated per the current Decathlon/Heptathlon tables
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Points per event equal the World Athletics (IAAF) combined-events scoring-table value for that event and result (INT of A*(B-P)^C for track, A*(P-B)^C for field). A deviating value is a finding with the calculation and expected value.

requirements.title: The table shows total points and placement per event
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The table shows the rank within each event, and also the total and the total position.

requirements.title: Ties share a placement
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Participants with equal totals show the same position. The position that follows a tie is not specified and is not judged.

requirements.title: Invalid results are rejected with a clear error message
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Negative, non-numeric, empty and unreasonable values for an event are rejected with a clear error message and the result is not saved.

requirements.title: Export CSV contains the same data as the table
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The exported CSV contains every participant, total, position and event value shown in the table. Column order and format are not specified and are not judged.

executions.summary: Verified: after adding TP-Anna to TP-AUD-20261105-01 the name is shown in the competitor selector and in the standings (counter 1); the console had no errors. Setup action: the competition was created first (ACT-001). Not verified: persistence, blank or special-character names, server-side behaviour.
Verified: TP-Bo and TP-Cia were added; all three names are shown and the competition counter shows 3. Not verified: more than three participants, duplicate names.

Verified: 100m 11.00 s saved for TP-Anna is shown in her 100m cell (11 s, 861); the status line says Saved: 861 pts; the console had no errors. Not verified: the other nine events, overwriting a result.

Verified: Long Jump (unit cm) 700 saved for TP-Bo is shown in his Long Jump cell (700 cm, 814). Test data deviation from the plan: 7.00 m was entered as 700 because the UI unit is cm. Not verified: other field events.
Verified: TP-Anna and TP-Cia both have total 861 and both show position 1. Not verified: ties in other totals, ties at lower positions, how ties are ordered inside the table.

Verified: TP-Bo (total 814 at that time, 1789 later) never shows the tied position; with the tie at 1, TP-Bo shows 3. After later data the table shows 1, 2, 3, then 4 and 4 (TP-V768 and TP-V375 tied) and 6. The position after a tie is therefore counted as in 1, 1, 3 and is recorded, not judged (CG-004).

Violated criterion: the table shows the rank within each event, plus total and total position. Observed: total (Total) and total position (Pos) are shown, but each event cell shows only the result and the points (TP-Bo 100m: 10.5 s, 975), and no rank within the event appears in the table, in its HTML, on hover, or elsewhere on the page. TP-Bo scored 975 pts in 100m (reference 975, matches). Reproduced: see EX-013. Cause checked: not a selector or timing fault (values read from the DOM and screenshot).

Verified for five Decathlon results against the World Athletics formula (INT of A*(B-P)^C): 100m 11.00 s = 861, Long Jump 700 cm = 814, 400m 50.00 s = 815, Shot Put 14.00 m = 728, 100m 10.50 s = 975; all equal the expected values. Not verified: the other Decathlon events (110m Hurdles, 1500m, High Jump, Pole Vault, Discus, Javelin) and every Heptathlon event (no Heptathlon competition was permitted by the scope, see EX-017); the reference constants were recalled by the agent and not read from the official document (CG-011).

Verified at 768 px: TP-V768 was added and a 100m result saved and shown (861); the page has no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth 753); the standings table scrolls inside its own container. Layout observations are heuristic-based and have no design reference.

Verified at 375 px: TP-V375 was added and a 100m result saved and shown (861); controls were readable and operable; the standings table scrolls inside its own container. Observation (heuristic-based, no requirement or design reference): the page is 8 px wider than the viewport (scrollWidth 383 against 375) and the element causing it was not identified (CG-014).

Verified: TP-Key was added with the keyboard only (Tab to Name, typing, Tab to Add competitor, Enter). Focus order from the Rename button was Name then Add competitor; a 2 px outline was present on each focused control; no keyboard trap was seen in that sequence. Setup note: focus was placed on the Rename button by script to start the sequence just before Name. No automated accessibility scan was performed; this does not establish WCAG 2.1 AA conformance.

Violated criterion: negative, non-numeric, empty and unreasonable values are rejected with a clear message and not saved. Observed for 100m: -1 (Result cannot be negative), abc (Enter the result in seconds (163) or as minutes:seconds (2:43)), empty (Result is required) and 0.5 (Faster than the world record for 100m: 9.58 s) were rejected with a visible message and not saved. 99999 (about 27.8 hours) was accepted: no error, Saved: 0 pts, the value is shown as 1666:39 and the server answered 200. Reproduced: see EX-016 and the reload check in EX-013. Not verified: other events, other unreasonable values, client versus server cause for each rejection.

Repeat of EX-007 by another route (page reload, then reading the standings, and the exported CSV). Violated criterion: rank within each event is shown. Observed again: the table cells hold only result and points, and the CSV has result and points columns per event, Total and Position, but no per-event rank. The data is persisted by the server (values unchanged after reload).

Verified (export 1 of 2): the CSV contains the same seven rows as the table with matching position, name, total, and result and points per event (for example TP-Bo 1, 10.5 / 975, 700 / 814, 1789). Results are shown as entered (TP-Key 99999 against 1666:39 in the table; same data, different format). Not verified: the Heptathlon tab, column order and format (not specified), other browsers. Observations: the Competition column holds the type (Decathlon); event names in the header are inconsistent (100m result, longJump result).

The check could not run: the required test data cannot be created. The app rejected TP-Csv, Comma and TP-Csv "Quote" with Name must contain valid letters (server answered 400 both times), so no name with a comma or quote exists. Needed to unblock: a participant name that the app accepts and that contains a CSV delimiter or quote, or confirmation that such names are intentionally not allowed. This is not recorded as a product defect: no requirement defines valid names.

Repeat of EX-012 attempt 5 with the same steps. Violated criterion: unreasonable values are rejected and not saved. Observed again: 99999 for 100m was accepted, Saved: 0 pts, cell 1666:39, server answered 200. Reproduced 2 of 2.

The check could not run: the competition TP-AUD-20261105-01 was created as type Decathlon and its Discipline control is disabled, so no Heptathlon result can be saved in it. A Heptathlon result needs a second competition of type Heptathlon; creating a second competition is not in the confirmed state-change limits (create_competition once per audit). Needed to unblock: user approval to create one Heptathlon competition whose name starts with TP-. The same limit prevented the Heptathlon part of TPI-008. Not recorded as a product defect.

coverage_gaps.description: Which position follows a tie is not judged. The requirement does not specify it. The app counts positions as 1, 1, 3 and 4, 4, 6 (EX-006).

Blank, duplicate, very long and special-character names, and which characters are valid are not verified. No criterion exists. Observation: names with a comma or quote were rejected with Name must contain valid letters (EX-015).

Results in the other events (7 Decathlon events not run), changing or overwriting an existing result, and persistence of each saved value are not verified. Only 100m, Long Jump, 400m and Shot Put were saved.
CSV from a Heptathlon competition, the CSV column order and format, a second export, and Save state / Load state are not verified. The format is not specified, and Save and Load are out of scope.
Rename competition, the dark mode toggle and the Actions column (edit) are not verified. No requirement covers them. Create competition was used only as setup.
Server-side validation is only observed through response codes (400 for rejected scores and names, 200 for accepted ones). Injection protection and server-side behaviour in general are not verified.

Saving a Heptathlon result (TPI-006) was not verified. The competition is of type Decathlon and its Discipline control is disabled; a second competition of type Heptathlon was not permitted by the scope (EX-017).

Points were compared only for 100m, Long Jump, 400m and Shot Put in Decathlon. 110m Hurdles, 1500m, High Jump, Pole Vault, Discus, Javelin and all Heptathlon events are not verified. Reference constants were recalled by the agent and not read from the official World Athletics document.
CSV handling of names with a comma or quote is not verified (TPI-014 blocked): the app does not accept such names (EX-015).
Invalid results were tried only for the 100m event and only with -1, abc, empty, 0.5 and 99999. Other events, other unreasonable values, boundary values and the exact limits are not verified.
The 8 px page-level horizontal overflow at 375 px (EX-010) is only observed. The overflowing element was not identified, and there is no design reference to judge it against.
